messages:
taylor: Posted a new mock for the per-route distribution widget — violin + overlaid jittered points to show extremes. Link: https://redwood.design/threads/violin-mock maria: Quick scan: looks promising. two immediate asks — 1) unit toggle in legend (ms / s) so product folks can see whichever they prefer, 2) tooltip should include both raw count and density % so it's clear what the violin height means jon: +1 on units. also smoothing currently hides short, high spikes (p99 bursts). we should expose a smoothing toggle and dial (or at least use a lighter default smoothing) kim: accessibility nits: color contrast between violin fill and overlay points fails for deuteranopia. also the SR text is currently "violin chart" which is useless. need an aria-label like: "latency distribution for route X — median 42 ms, p95 120 ms, 2 points > 1s" taylor: noted. proposal: default smoothing = gaussian sigma 0.8, show top-right control for Smoothing (on/off + slider). units dropdown inline in legend (default to system/route unit). tooltip shows raw value and density percent. want to keep the violin readable for dense traffic without erasing spikes maria: about outliers — I'd prefer clipping by percentile for the plotted violin (e.g., clip to 99.5%) and render extreme points beyond that as jittered points with a slightly bigger hit area. keeps density meaningful while not hiding extremes jon: if we clip we must annotate the axis: e.g. "Latency (ms, clipped to 99.5%)". also when you hover a jitter point show the original un-clipped value. otherwise people will be confused when their big values vanish design-bot: Checklist added to PR #412: color-contrast 4.5:1 verified, keyboard focus order defined, screen-reader summary string included, unit toggle implemented, smoothing toggle + slider added kim: copy nit: legend helper text should read "Toggle units for axis & tooltips" instead of just "units" — clearer for non-technical PMs taylor: example aria + focus snippet I plan to include in the PR: ```html
/* keyboard focus ring */ .violin:focus { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; } ``` maria: I'll add Storybook fixtures with long descriptions for SR testing and an automated axe run in CI. also adding an integration test that toggles smoothing + unit switch to ensure the axis label updates. jon: :thumbsup:
